guards.must_include: inside binomial noise|not a demonstrated performance advantage|WORST method|0\.227
guards.why: the opening clause 'THE GEODESIC DETECTOR WINS ON THE REAL TASK' is the flattering half; the margin is two recordings on fifteen (inside binomial noise) and detection was the worst method compared before repair. The rendered headline must not stop before that.
'CRITERION MET' alone reads as a validated multiscale bank; the operative finding is that a single large window already matches it.
the repair lifted detection to 0.81, which is competitive but not superior to the best baseline's 0.88; the headline must not imply a win.

supersessions.note: the synthetic ratio sweep reported robustness at every ratio; on real data the paradigm-ordering assumption it rests on is REFUTED and the ratio mechanism is right-signed but weak (rho = -0.36, n.s.).
the synthetic no-benefit finding is now replicated on real EEG (covariate-argmax 1/15 at every bandwidth).
the 4/15 local window-mean result is superseded as the best available detector by the global geodesic CUSUM at 8/15, which is still short of the pre-registered band.
